slides.eyebrow: Paying to park at your train station?
slides.sub: One Morris County station has 281 parking spots and no parking fee. There's one catch.

slides.title: 2 train lines
slides.body: Mount Arlington is on both lines, with limited service. Through Nov. 14, NJ Transit plans to run weekday Midtown Direct trains to Hoboken. Check the timetable.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Mount Arlington Station; Village Green (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: 281 spots, no fee
slides.body: NJ Transit's lot has 274 standard and 7 accessible spaces, with no fee for anyone. The catch: no overnight parking.

slides.title: Right off I-80
slides.body: The station sits at the Howard Boulevard exit. There's no ticket agent, just one machine in the plaza by the tunnel.
slides.source: NJ Transit, Mount Arlington Station; Wikipedia (Nov. 2026)

slides.title: Your commute
slides.tip: Before you make an offer, drive from the house to the station at rush hour.
